---
title: "Sensitivity Analysis: Proximal Minority Stress Components"
author: "XXXX"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

The primary model uses a composite of three proximal minority stress components. This file re-estimates the final model separately for each component: rejection sensitivity (Table S6), internalised homonegativity (Table S7) and concealment (Table S8). It also re-estimates the final model with concealment removed from the composite (Table S11). Methods are described in Supplementary Material S4.

Each component's trajectory, autoregressive paths and within-time covariances are chosen with the same steps used in the primary analysis. Distress is modelled exactly as in the primary analysis.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(MplusAutomation)

# Set WD
set.seed(123)
setwd("C:XXXX")

# Import data
GZMCore <- readRDS("C:XXXX")

# Fit indices reported in the tables
fit_cols <- c("Title", "Parameters", "ChiSqM_Value", "ChiSqM_DF", "ChiSqM_PValue",
              "CFI", "RMSEA_Estimate", "RMSEA_90CI_LB", "RMSEA_90CI_UB", "SRMR", "AIC", "BIC")

# Scaled chi-square difference test for models estimated with MLR
# (Satorra-Bentler, calculated from the log-likelihoods)
# "simpler" is the model with fewer parameters, "fuller" the model with more
scaled_diff_test <- function(simpler, fuller) {
  m0 <- readModels(simpler, what = "summaries")$summaries
  m1 <- readModels(fuller,  what = "summaries")$summaries
  df_diff    <- m1$Parameters - m0$Parameters
  scaling    <- (m1$Parameters * m1$LLCorrectionFactor - m0$Parameters * m0$LLCorrectionFactor) / df_diff
  chisq_diff <- -2 * (m0$LL - m1$LL) / scaling
  c(ChiSq_diff = round(chisq_diff, 3),
    df         = df_diff,
    p          = round(pchisq(chisq_diff, df_diff, lower.tail = FALSE), 4))
}
```

# Mplus Data

Short variable names: `a` = rejection sensitivity, `b` = internalised homonegativity, `c` = concealment, `y` = distress, `m2` to `m5` = monthly identity experience counts.

```{r mplus data}
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Proximal minority stress composite (x) and distress (y), W0 to W4
    x1 = StressComp_W0, x2 = StressComp_W1, x3 = StressComp_W2, x4 = StressComp_W3, x5 = StressComp_W4,
    y1 = DASS_Total_W0, y2 = DASS_Total_W1, y3 = DASS_Total_W2, y4 = DASS_Total_W3, y5 = DASS_Total_W4,

    # Gender: 0 = cisgender, 1 = trans or gender diverse
    gender = case_when(GenderGroup %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0, GenderGroup %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1),

    # Ethnoracial identity: 0 = White, 1 = People of Colour
    race = case_when(RaceAnalysis == 1 ~ 0, RaceAnalysis == 2 ~ 1),

    # Age and baseline (lifetime) identity experience count, centred on the sample mean
    Age0    = Age - mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0 = msbase - mean(msbase, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Baseline distress group: 0 = at or below the median, 1 = above the median
    dgrp = case_when(y1 <= median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0, y1 > median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1)
  )

GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    a1 = SMARSS_W0, a2 = SMARSS_W1, a3 = SMARSS_W2, a4 = SMARSS_W3, a5 = SMARSS_W4,
    b1 = IntHom_W0, b2 = IntHom_W1, b3 = IntHom_W2, b4 = IntHom_W3, b5 = IntHom_W4,
    c1 = NOSC_S_W0, c2 = NOSC_S_W1, c3 = NOSC_S_W2, c4 = NOSC_S_W3, c5 = NOSC_S_W4
  )

# The univariate models use a data file without the baseline distress group
mplus_c <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5,
         c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, msbase0, Age0, gender, race)
mplus_c[is.na(mplus_c)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_c, "modelc.dat")
```

# Growth Shape

```{r rejection sensitivity growth}
# Intercept only
mplusSyntaxG1RS <- ("
TITLE: G1RS Intercept-only growth model - Rejection Sensitivity;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix | a1@0 a2@0 a3@0 a4@0 a5@0;
  [ix];
  ix;
  [a1-a5@0];
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG1RS, "modelg1rs.inp")

# Fixed linear slope
mplusSyntaxG2RS <- ("
TITLE: G2RS Fixed linear slope growth model - Rejection Sensitivity;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx@0;
  [a1-a5@0];
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG2RS, "modelg2rs.inp")

# Random linear slope (retained)
mplusSyntaxG3RS <- ("
TITLE: G3RS Random linear slope growth model - Rejection Sensitivity;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx;
  ix WITH sx;
  [a1-a5@0];
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG3RS, "modelg3rs.inp")

# Freed time scores
mplusSyntaxG4RS <- ("
TITLE: G4RS Freed time scores growth model - Rejection Sensitivity;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | a1@0 a2* a3* a4* a5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;
  [a1-a5@0];
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG4RS, "modelg4rs.inp")
```

# Autoregressive Paths

```{r autoregressive models}
# Rejection sensitivity: free
mplusSyntaxG5RS_free <- ("
TITLE: G5RS_free RS - random linear slope + free AR structured residuals;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx;
  ix WITH sx;
  [a1-a5@0];

  ra1 BY a1@1; ra2 BY a2@1; ra3 BY a3@1; ra4 BY a4@1; ra5 BY a5@1;
  [ra1-ra5@0];
  a1-a5@0;

  ra1;
  ra2-ra5 (vsa);

  ra2 ON ra1 (ar1a);
  ra3 ON ra2 (ar2a);
  ra4 ON ra3 (ar3a);
  ra5 ON ra4 (ar4a);
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG5RS_free, "modelg5rs_free.inp")

# Rejection sensitivity: equal
mplusSyntaxG5RS_eq <- ("
TITLE: G5RS_eq RS - random linear slope + equality-constrained AR structured residuals;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx;
  ix WITH sx;
  [a1-a5@0];

  ra1 BY a1@1; ra2 BY a2@1; ra3 BY a3@1; ra4 BY a4@1; ra5 BY a5@1;
  [ra1-ra5@0];
  a1-a5@0;

  ra1;
  ra2-ra5 (vsa);

  ra2 ON ra1 (ara);
  ra3 ON ra2 (ara);
  ra4 ON ra3 (ara);
  ra5 ON ra4 (ara);
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG5RS_eq, "modelg5rs_eq.inp")

# Internalised homonegativity: free
mplusSyntaxG5IS_free <- ("
TITLE: G5IS_free IS - intercept only + free AR structured residuals;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = b1-b5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix | b1@0 b2@0 b3@0 b4@0 b5@0;
  [ix];
  ix;
  [b1-b5@0];

  rb1 BY b1@1; rb2 BY b2@1; rb3 BY b3@1; rb4 BY b4@1; rb5 BY b5@1;
  [rb1-rb5@0];
  b1-b5@0;

  rb1;
  rb2-rb5 (vsb);

  rb2 ON rb1 (ar1b);
  rb3 ON rb2 (ar2b);
  rb4 ON rb3 (ar3b);
  rb5 ON rb4 (ar4b);
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
```

```{r run autoregressive models}
runModels("modelg5rs_free.inp")
runModels("modelg5rs_eq.inp")
runModels("modelg5is_free.inp")
runModels("modelg5is_eq.inp")
runModels("modelg5co_free.inp")
runModels("modelg5co_eq.inp")

rbind(
  "Rejection sensitivity: adding autoregressive paths"   = scaled_diff_test("modelg3rs.out", "modelg5rs_free.out"),
  "Rejection sensitivity: equal vs free"                 = scaled_diff_test("modelg5rs_eq.out", "modelg5rs_free.out"),
  "Internalised homonegativity: adding autoregressive"   = scaled_diff_test("modelg1is.out", "modelg5is_free.out"),
  "Internalised homonegativity: equal vs free"           = scaled_diff_test("modelg5is_eq.out", "modelg5is_free.out"),
  "Concealment: adding autoregressive paths"             = scaled_diff_test("modelg1co.out", "modelg5co_free.out"),
  "Concealment: equal vs free"                           = scaled_diff_test("modelg5co_eq.out", "modelg5co_free.out")
)
```

# Bivariate Models: Within-Time Covariances

Each component is paired with distress, and the same-month covariance is tested with and without an equality constraint.

```{r mplus data with distress group}
# The same data file, now with the baseline distress group added
mplus_c <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5,
         c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_c[is.na(mplus_c)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_c, "modelc.dat")
```

```{r bivariate models}
mplusSyntaxBivRS_eq <- ("
TITLE: BIV_RS_eq Bivariate LCM-SR - Rejection Sensitivity + Distress (wcov equal);
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = a1-a5 y1-y5 dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ! RS trajectory - random linear slope
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances (sy omitted - variance fixed)
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [a1-a5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! RS structured residuals
  ra1 BY a1@1; ra2 BY a2@1; ra3 BY a3@1; ra4 BY a4@1; ra5 BY a5@1;
  [ra1-ra5@0];
  a1-a5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  ra1;
  ra2-ra5 (vsa);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! RS AR - equality constrained (supported, p = .175)
  ra2 ON ra1 (ara);
  ra3 ON ra2 (ara);
  ra4 ON ra3 (ara);
  ra5 ON ra4 (ara);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated (non-stationary, as per primary analysis)
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - equality constrained (tested below)
  ra1 WITH ry1;
  ra2 WITH ry2 (wcov_rs);
  ra3 WITH ry3 (wcov_rs);
  ra4 WITH ry4 (wcov_rs);
  ra5 WITH ry5 (wcov_rs);

  ix ON dgrp;
  sx ON dgrp;
  iy ON dgrp;
OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxBivRS_eq, "modelbivrs_eq.inp")
```

```{r run bivariate models}
runModels("modelbivrs_eq.inp")
runModels("modelbivrs_free.inp")
runModels("modelbIvis_eq.inp")
runModels("modelbIvis_free.inp")
runModels("modelbivco_eq.inp")
runModels("modelbivco_free.inp")

rbind(
  "Rejection sensitivity: equal vs free"       = scaled_diff_test("modelbivrs_eq.out", "modelbivrs_free.out"),
  "Internalised homonegativity: equal vs free" = scaled_diff_test("modelbIvis_eq.out", "modelbIvis_free.out"),
  "Concealment: equal vs free"                 = scaled_diff_test("modelbivco_eq.out", "modelbivco_free.out")
)
```

```{r component final models}
# Table S6: rejection sensitivity
mplusSyntaxCondRS <- ("
TITLE: COND_RS Final conditional LCM-SR - Rejection Sensitivity;
DATA:
  FILE = modelc.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 a1-a5 b1-b5 c1-c5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = m2-m5 a1-a5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ! RS trajectory - random linear slope
  ix sx | a1@0 a2@1 a3@2 a4@3 a5@4;
  [ix sx];
  ix;
  sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [a1-a5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! RS structured residuals
  ra1 BY a1@1; ra2 BY a2@1; ra3 BY a3@1; ra4 BY a4@1; ra5 BY a5@1;
  [ra1-ra5@0];
  a1-a5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  ra1;
  ra2-ra5 (vsa);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! RS AR - equality constrained
  ra2 ON ra1 (ara);
  ra3 ON ra2 (ara);
  ra4 ON ra3 (ara);
  ra5 ON ra4 (ara);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - equality constrained (retained per LRT p = .140)
  ra1 WITH ry1;
  ra2 WITH ry2 (wcov_rs);
  ra3 WITH ry3 (wcov_rs);
  ra4 WITH ry4 (wcov_rs);
  ra5 WITH ry5 (wcov_rs);

  ! Contemporaneous SIDE effects - equality constrained across waves
  ra2 ON m2 (sides_a_con);
  ra3 ON m3 (sides_a_con);
  ra4 ON m4 (sides_a_con);
  ra5 ON m5 (sides_a_con);

  ry2 ON m2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON m3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON m4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON m5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Covariates predicting growth factors
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

  ! Covariates predicting milestone exposure
  m2-m5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxCondRS, "modelcond_rs.inp")
```

```{r component final models fit}
# Model fit (reported in each table note)
bind_rows(
  readModels("modelcond_rs.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modelcond_is.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modelcond_co.out", what = "summaries")$summaries
) %>%
  select(any_of(fit_cols))
```

```{r table s6}
rs <- readModels("modelcond_rs.out", what = "parameters")$parameters
table_s6 <- rs$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(rs$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s6, "TableS6_rejection_sensitivity.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Key results: identity experience effects and between-person covariances
filter(table_s6, param %in% c("M2", "M3", "M4", "M5"))
filter(table_s6, paramHeader %in% c("IX.WITH", "SX.WITH"))
```

# Composite Without Concealment (Table S11)

The final model is re-estimated with a composite of rejection sensitivity and internalised homonegativity only. All other specifications match the primary model.

```{r mplus data without concealment}
# The composite without concealment is read as x1 to x5 in Mplus
mplus_e <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(xe1 = StressComp_s_W0, xe2 = StressComp_s_W1, xe3 = StressComp_s_W2,
         xe4 = StressComp_s_W3, xe5 = StressComp_s_W4) %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, xe1, xe2, xe3, xe4, xe5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5,
         msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_e[is.na(mplus_e)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_e, "modele.dat")
```

```{r composite without concealment model}
# The monthly counts are named mw2 to mw5 here, but they are the standard (unweighted) counts
mplusSyntaxConc_excl <- ("
TITLE: Concealment Removed Sensitivity - Final conditional LCM-SR;

DATA:
  FILE = modele.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - freely estimated
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous SIDE effects - equality constrained
  rx2 ON mw2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON mw3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON mw4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON mw5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON mw2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON mw3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON mw4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON mw5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting growth factors
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting milestone exposure
  mw2-mw5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxConc_excl, "modelconc_excl.inp")
runModels("modelconc_excl.inp")
```

```{r table s11}
ce <- readModels("modelconc_excl.out", what = c("summaries", "parameters"))
select(ce$summaries, any_of(fit_cols))

table_s11 <- ce$parameters$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(ce$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s11, "TableS11_concealment_excluded.csv", row.names = FALSE)

filter(table_s11, param %in% c("MW2", "MW3", "MW4", "MW5"))
filter(table_s11, paramHeader %in% c("IX.WITH", "SX.WITH"))
```
